frontier_coordinate: R-116 proves the same-root endpoint square-minus-trace quotient, partial-Wick Sigma-Q owner firewall, fresh first-chaos determinant absorption, optimized conditional-Holder composition, and exact finite-dimensional polynomial quadratic parabolic-tangent recession classifier. It also classifies the active R-082 finite-Fourier nulls as plane waves and gives their real-linearized symbol. The live successor is a cutoff/floor-uniform metric margin for the complete rational-homogeneous R-082 root, followed by its full A1 one-fresh-root contraction-closed owner-preserving conditional embedding with every visit and owner retained exactly once. A separate one-use source/sextic aggregation must then be proved. R-115's stationary scalar theorem, R-103 REG, and R-087 fixed-cutoff CORE retain their owners. OVERLAP_src, Nelson, removals, interacting measure, and Sector A remain open.

new_claim_criteria: The statement is mathematically independent of the current parent objective.
The scope and falsifier remain meaningful when cited without the parent proof diary.
The result has its own reproducible verification package or an explicitly staged package plan.
The result is intended to be a durable external citation target.
The unit is not merely a lemma, route comparison, obstruction, counterexample, or next gate inside an active claim.
